SELECT
    l_returnflag,
    l_linestatus,
    SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
    SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price,
    SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) * (1 + l_tax)) AS sum_charge,
    AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_qty,
    AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_price,
    AVG(l_discount) AS avg_disc,
    COUNT(*) AS count_order
FROM lineitem
WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1998-09-02'
GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

SELECT
    n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
    lineitem l
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
    JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
    JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n3 ON s.s_nationkey = n3.n_nationkey
WHERE
    n1.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
    AND n2.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY')
    AND n1.n_name != n2.n_name
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY
    supp_nation,
    cust_nation,
    l_year
ORDER BY
    supp_nation,
    cust_nation,
    l_year

SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand != 'Brand#45'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
    AND s.s_acctbal > 0
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC

SELECT
        l.l_shipmode,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count
    FROM
        lineitem l
    JOIN
        orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    WHERE
        l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
        AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
        AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
        AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
        AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
    GROUP BY
        l.l_shipmode
    ORDER BY
        l.l_shipmode

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
  FROM lineitem l
  JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' 
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
  GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
)
SELECT 
  s_suppkey,
  s_name,
  s_address,
  s_phone,
  total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)
ORDER BY s_suppkey

FROM lineitem
JOIN part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey

  AND l_shipinstruct = 'DELIVER IN PERSON'
  AND (

      (p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND p_container IN ('MED BAG', 'MED BOX', 'MED PKG', 'MED PACK') AND l_quantity BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 10)
      OR
      (p_brand = 'Brand#34' AND p_container IN ('LG CASE', 'LG BOX', 'LG PACK', 'LG PKG') AND l_quantity BETWEEN 20 AND 30 AND p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 15)
  )

WITH min_cost AS (
            SELECT ps_partkey, MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
            FROM partsupp
            GROUP BY ps_partkey
        )
        SELECT
            s.s_acctbal,
            s.s_name,
            n.n_name,
            p.p_partkey,
            p.p_mfgr,
            s.s_address,
            s.s_phone,
            s.s_comment
        FROM partsupp ps
        JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
        JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
        WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
          AND p.p_size = 15
          AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
          AND ps.ps_supplycost = (SELECT min_cost FROM min_cost WHERE ps_partkey = p.p_partkey)
        ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name ASC, s.s_name ASC, p.p_partkey ASC
        LIMIT 100

SELECT
  n.n_name,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
  region r
  JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
  JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE
  r.r_name = 'ASIA'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY
  n.n_name
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC

SELECT

  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - (ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity)) AS sum_profit
FROM lineitem l
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%'
GROUP BY n.n_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY n.n_name ASC, o_year DESC

SELECT
    l.l_shipmode,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY l.l_shipmode

WITH part_min_cost AS (
  SELECT 
    p_partkey,
    MIN(ps_supplycost) AS min_cost
  FROM partsupp
  JOIN part ON ps_partkey = p_partkey
  WHERE p_size = 15 
    AND p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
  GROUP BY p_partkey
)
SELECT 
  s.s_acctbal,
  s.s_name,
  n.n_name,
  p.p_partkey,
  p.p_mfgr,
  s.s_address,
  s.s_phone,
  s.s_comment
FROM partsupp ps
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE p.p_size = 15
  AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS'
  AND r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
  AND ps.ps_supplycost = (SELECT min_cost FROM part_min_cost WHERE p_partkey = p.p_partkey)
ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_partkey
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  n.n_name,
  SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
  region r
  JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
  JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
  JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
  JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
  r.r_name = 'ASIA'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY
  n.n_name
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC

  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_acctbal,
    SUBSTR(c.c_phone, 1, 2) AS cntrycode
  FROM customer c
  WHERE SUBSTR(c.c_phone, 1, 2) IN ('13','31','23','29','30','18','17')

results.sql:
SELECT
    l.l_shipmode,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS high_line_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 END) AS low_line_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY
    l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY
    l.l_shipmode

      l_linestatus,
      SUM(l_quantity) AS sum_qty,
      SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price,

      COUNT(*) AS count_order
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE l_shipdate <= '1998-09-02'
    GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
    ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus

SELECT
    n.n_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
    region r
    JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
    JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
    JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC

SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand != 'Brand#45'
    AND p.p_type NOT LIKE 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
    AND p.p_size IN (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
    AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%Customer%Complaints%'
    AND s.s_acctbal > 0
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand,
    p.p_type,
    p.p_size
ORDER BY
    supplier_cnt DESC,
    p.p_brand ASC,
    p.p_type ASC,
    p.p_size ASC
```

results.sql:
SELECT
            n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
            n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS l_year,
            SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
        FROM
            lineitem l
            JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
            JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
            JOIN nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
            JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
            JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
            JOIN nation n3 ON s.s_nationkey = n3.n_nationkey
        WHERE
            n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR n1.n_name = 'GERMANY'
            AND n2.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR n2.n_name = 'GERMANY'
            AND n3.n_name = 'FRANCE' OR n3.n_name = 'GERMANY'
            AND n1.n_name != n2.n_name
            AND n1.n_name != n3.n_name
            AND n2.n_name != n3.n_name
            AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
        GROUP BY
            n1.n_name,
            n2.n_name,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
        ORDER BY
            n1.n_name,
            n2.n_name,
            l_year

SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH supplier_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
  FROM lineitem l
  JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' 
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
  GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone
)
SELECT 
  s_suppkey,
  s_name,
  s_address,
  s_phone,
  total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)

SELECT
    l.l_shipmode,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority NOT IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP')
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate
GROUP BY
    l.l_shipmode
ORDER BY
    l.l_shipmode
